name: fischer BauBot MRS15
summary: A 1.3 t tracked robot with an industrial arm that drills, cleans and sets fischer anchors in ceilings, walls and floors from the BIM model, run by a fischer operator.

sellers.note: Offered as a full service: BIM model, anchor design, robot, certified operator and documentation. Site work is run by fischer BauBot Services GmbH. No machine sale found.
sellers.name: fischerwerke GmbH & Co. KG (fischer BauBot Services GmbH)

germany.statusNote: Available in Germany as a drilling and anchoring service from fischer (robot with fischer operator, planning and documentation), not as a machine you buy. Price on request.

specs.label: Working height
specs.conditions: up to, without lifting frame; with lifting frame used up to 7.5 m in a tunnel

specs.label: Transport size
specs.conditions: fits through a standard door in transport position

specs.label: Anchors set
specs.value: fischer EA II drop-in anchor, RSB resin capsule

notes: Not fully autonomous: an operator positions it, releases each work step and supervises; lidar safety zone around the robot.
Automatic drill bit change, hole cleaning, marking and anchor setting; integrated dust extraction.
Tracked base with outriggers seen in Baubot photos; drive not described in text. Stabilises itself hydraulically when working.
Service only in Germany; you hire the result, not the machine.
Maker says it works indoors and outdoors (IP54-equivalent, 5-40 °C, under 85% humidity).

evidence.note: Night shifts under live traffic; fischer supplied the drilling plan, operators, drill bits and documentation.

evidence.task: Set anchors for handrails and water pipe fixings along the tunnel

evidence.note: Base model of the record robot not named in the source.
